exclusion_classification.justification: PV86 contracts may contain floats: wasmparser features enable MVP floats and saturating float-to-int (`runtime/near-vm-runner/src/features.rs:47-59`, `SATURATING_FLOAT_TO_INT=true`). Lean rejects them at preparation (`Wasm/Prepare.lean:205,234,315`). 160 protocol-valid cases excluded.

SECP256K1 is a live key type and Delegate signature scheme at PV86 (`core/crypto/src/signature.rs:250-257`; `KeyType::SECP256K1`). Lean throws at `D2/Actions.lean:399`; 41 protocol-valid cases excluded.

ML-DSA-65 is enabled at PV85 (`core/primitives-core/src/version.rs:414,567`; `85.yaml` adds `ml_dsa_65_verification_cost`). Lean treats ML-DSA keys/signatures as `w.shape` (`D2/Types.lean:34-35,46`); 118 protocol-valid cases excluded.

Global contracts, deterministic state init and gas keys are live at PV83/85 (`Action` tags 9-11, `core/primitives/src/action/mod.rs:349-370`; `version.rs:553-562`; `GlobalContractDistributionNonce`, `GasKeys`). Lean rejects them at `D2/Types.lean:36-39,300-302` and `D3/FunctionCall.lean:248`; 317 protocol-valid cases excluded.

Legacy ETH-wallet resolution is deterministic given `chain_id` (`runtime/runtime/src/contract_code.rs:56-76`, `eth_wallet_global_contract_hash`), not random. Lean conservatively excludes it (`D3/FunctionCall.lean:236-239`); 223 protocol-valid cases excluded.

Dynamic resharding is enabled at PV85 (`version.rs:342,564`); the validator has a resharding transition path (`chain_validation.rs:258-308`, `ImplicitTransitionParams::Resharding`, `reassign_outgoing_receipts_for_resharding` at :638) and mainnet genesis sets `dynamic_resharding: true` (`utils/mainnet-res/res/mainnet_genesis.json`). Lean excludes any layout change (`ChunkValidationD2.lean:140`) and any split gate (:156). The 1,127 oracle marks are a stale multi-epoch classifier: all have one layout and 700 are accepted. No genuine resharding case is in the corpus.

The genesis main transition is a first-class validator branch (`chain_validation.rs:403-411`, `MainTransition::Genesis`, `Chain::genesis_chunk_extra`) and claim-v3 T14 carries `genesis_chunk_extra`. Lean excludes it (`ChunkValidationD2.lean:176`); 137 protocol-valid cases excluded.

exclusion_classification.classification: capacity choice, not a boundary condition
exclusion_classification.justification: `G_α` is a prover table-size cap (`D3/FunctionCall.lean:389`, `D3_WASM_REQUIREMENTS.md` §2.4), not a nearcore condition; nearcore accepts all 1,010 tagged chunks. A chunk above `G_α` is protocol-valid.

nearcore's verdict depends on the compiled-contract cache (`oracle/v3-d3/src/d3judge.rs` ColdCache; `function_call.rs:355-393` records the access, `pipelining.rs:323-374` may reuse a preparation). For a *rolled-back* in-chunk deploy the verdict is genuinely cache-dependent, so no cache-independent relation can decide it. For a *committed* deploy the deploy tracker serves the code deterministically (`contract.rs:42-131`), so those 169 cold-accepted cases are decidable; Lean's blanket rule (`D3/FunctionCall.lean:268-275`) excludes them anyway.

exclusion_classification.classification: arena-format bound, not a validator condition
exclusion_classification.justification: The 32-block bound is a claim-size budget (`spec/claim-v3.md` §5 `max_claim_bytes`), not a nearcore rule; the validator's backward walk (`chain_validation.rs:144-253`) has no such limit. Three protocol-valid claims have 41/41/43 blocks and are excluded by `ChunkValidationD2.lean:144`.

oracle_marks.note: 1,127 claims carry the tag. A full claim scan shows none has two different shard layouts and none has a split gate; 274 have a single epoch, 850 have two epochs with byte-identical layouts, 3 have 3-4 identical layouts. 700 are ACCEPTED by Lean, Python and nearcore; the other 427 leave the domain for some other reason. The Lean guards are `c.same_layout`/`c.no_split_gate` (D2:140,156), which never fire here. The tag is therefore a false-positive oracle classifier (an older single-epoch rule), not a Lean-vs-nearcore disagreement (the recorded difftest still shows 0 disagreements). Consequence: the resharding path is completely untested, and the mark will mask real resharding gaps until it is fixed.

unresolved_boundary_questions.question: Must `Rel_D3` be cache-independent, and is the cold-cache statement the one the arena admits?
unresolved_boundary_questions.why: spec/near-chunk-validation-d3.md §10.0 decision 1 fixes cold-cache; the signed challenge and successor API must state it. Gate B cannot claim 'every protocol-valid case' while a validator-cache parameter changes the verdict.

unresolved_boundary_questions.question: Can `e.code_cache` be narrowed to rolled-back deploys (committed deploys are served by `ContractsTracker`)?
unresolved_boundary_questions.why: 169 of 279 code-cache cases are cold-validator accepts; `contract.rs:104-131` makes a committed deploy deterministic. Narrowing needs a proof and a re-run.

unresolved_boundary_questions.question: Which NaN payload/sign semantics does the pinned Wasmtime produce, and is that stable across validator architectures?
unresolved_boundary_questions.why: Float types/ops are accepted at PV86 (`features.rs:47-59`); H3 in `docs/research/near-wasm-boundary.md` says canonical NaN sign on non-x86 is an assumption.

unresolved_boundary_questions.question: Are the curve host-function gas schedules fully pinned at PV86 (there is no `86.yaml`)?
unresolved_boundary_questions.why: `core/parameters/res/runtime_configs/` has 79/82/83/84/85.yaml and `parameters.snap`; the D3 spec says PV86 params are the 85 snapshot. Curve costs must come from the snapshot, not a 86 file.

unresolved_boundary_questions.question: Is the ML-DSA-65 trie key handle (SHA3-256 of the pubkey) part of the pinned claim/trie model?
unresolved_boundary_questions.why: `core/crypto/src/signature.rs:498-506`, `core/primitives/src/trie_key.rs:182,327` use `PublicKeyHandle::MlDsa65`; `D2/Types.lean:18` says the handle is not formalized.

unresolved_boundary_questions.question: Which global-contract / state-init receipts can appear in `source_receipt_proofs` at PV86, and are `GlobalContractDistribution` receipts ever in a chunk witness?
unresolved_boundary_questions.why: `D2/Types.lean:15` models tag 4 as `w.shape`; `version.rs:553-562` gates distribution nonce at 83.

unresolved_boundary_questions.question: Is the `LegacyEthWallet` branch still reachable at PV86 after `EthImplicitGlobalContract` (83), and which wallet hashes must be enumerated?
unresolved_boundary_questions.why: `contract_code.rs:56-76`: with `eth_implicit_global_contract` on, the legacy path becomes a `Global{eth_wallet_global_contract_hash(chain_id)}`.

unresolved_boundary_questions.question: Which witness carries a resharding transition, and must `retain_split_shard` / child congestion info be modelled per child shard?
May a valid segment reference a PV85 epoch (a protocol-version activation boundary), and does the pinned target require both PV85 and PV86 runtime configs?
unresolved_boundary_questions.why: `ChunkValidationD2.lean:125,139` require pv=86 for every epoch; the claim table can contain a pre-activation epoch. `epoch_start_after` already models the boundary.

unresolved_boundary_questions.question: Which predicate is the statement of record: `checkD3` (implementation) or `Wasm.DomainD3.noResharding`/`contractInD3α` (unused, and stricter on curve imports)?
unresolved_boundary_questions.why: `DomainD3.lean:23,59` are not referenced by `checkD3`; `contractInD3α` rejects curve *imports* while the checker accepts them (P3). `noResharding_spec` is proved but disconnected.

unresolved_boundary_questions.question: Does Gate B require removing the arena claim-size bounds (`c.segment` 32 blocks, `w.size` 4 MB/8 MiB), or is a larger versioned claim format acceptable?
unresolved_boundary_questions.why: `ChunkValidationD2.lean:120,144,237`; `claim-v3.md` §5 sets `max_claim_bytes` from these bounds. These are not validator conditions.

unresolved_boundary_questions.question: Does Gate B require unbounded chunk function-call gas (segmented proof), or is a stated `G_α` capacity contract acceptable?
unresolved_boundary_questions.why: `G_α` is a prover table bound; 1,010 corpus chunks exceed it and nearcore accepts them. The plan says 'every protocol-valid case'.

unresolved_boundary_questions.question: What admission contract binds the trusted facts (`chain_id`, validators, `minimum_stake`, `tx_valid`, RS params, `genesis_chunk_extra`) to the verifier's own chain state?

unresolved_boundary_questions.why: `docs/research/near-wasm-boundary.md` §8 H2/H9/H10 assume them absent; `Prepare.lean` models only `LinkError` and compile errors.

unresolved_boundary_questions.question: Is `Σ|values| + 2000·R ≤ 4 000 000` a sound upper bound on `recorded_storage_size_upper_bound` when contract-storage removals are present?
